retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast composition featuring a dark silhouette of a rider against a bright landscape with mixed script and block typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square graphic featuring a black silhouette of a cowgirl on a horse positioned on the right, set against a background of a blue sky and a golden hay field. The left side is dominated by two distinct typographic styles: a pink, outlined cursive script and a white, bold sans-serif block font.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouette overlaps the sky and field background
Script text is layered over the sky area
Block text is anchored in the lower field area
High contrast between black silhouette and bright background colors
coreInvariants: Split background of blue sky and golden field
Dual-font hierarchy with pink script and white block text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The rider silhouette is large-scale, occupying the right half of the frame from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horse's head and the rider's torso create a vertical anchor on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the pink script in the top left, moves down to the white block text, and then follows the silhouette's profile on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue sky provides open space for the primary text to breathe.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky and field; maximum value contrast between the black silhouette and white block text.

letterConstructionRules: Script: Slanted, connected, high-contrast strokes with rounded terminals
Sans-serif: Extra-bold, condensed, uniform stroke width with flat terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters feature a thick black outer stroke and a thin inner highlight stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, feminine script and rigid, masculine block lettering.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, casual, yet bold nature of the top text.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square landscape image with a bright blue sky with wispy clouds on the top half and a golden hay field with round bales on the bottom half. Place a solid black silhouette of a woman in a cowboy hat riding a horse on the right side, facing left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary text in a pink script font with a thick black outline in the top left. Add the secondary text in a bold, white, condensed sans-serif font with a black drop shadow in the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear distinction between the script and block fonts?
Is the text legible against the background?
Is the composition balanced between the text on the left and silhouette on the right?

mustRedesign: Ensure the silhouette is a generic representation of a rider

avoid: Cluttered backgrounds that obscure the silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Verify the horizon line is roughly centered
Ensure the pink script has a visible black outline
Confirm the white text is in all caps
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette of [Subject] + [Landscape Background] + [Script Display Text] + [Bold Block Subtitle]
